elements.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
elements.evidence: Rendered language omits original § 7.2 and retains Vendor’s acknowledgment that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment.

elements.element: The Customer MFN covers only a defined product.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN exists in the rendered language, so there is no broader product scope requiring limitation.

elements.element: The Customer MFN lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN exists in the rendered language, so no MFN duration exceeds 12 months.

elements.element: The Customer MFN contains reasonable like-for-like comparison carve-outs.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN exists in the rendered language; therefore, comparison carve-outs are unnecessary and the triggering condition is absent.
